sources.aod: ECMWF/CAMS/NRT organic-matter AOD at 550 nm, same averaging as pm25
sources.pm25: ECMWF/CAMS/NRT surface PM2.5, daily mean of forecast steps < 12 h (UTC day)
sources.fires: FIRMS (MODIS active fire, 1 km) — km² of pixels with ≥1 detection per 0.1° cell

pm25.encoding: base64 uint8 per day, row-major from top-left; µg/m³ = (v / q)²

aod.encoding: base64 uint8 per day, row-major from top-left; AOD = (v / q)²
